source: Coordinates: OpenStreetMap (terminal building outlines, aeroway=terminal), looked up via the Overpass API on 2026-10-11. Times: the team's demo estimates.
note: Ride hand-off points for Uber deep links (CLAUDE.md, Ride handoff). verified=false means the team has NOT checked the point on site or against the airport's own signage: the app then says 'Approximate drop-off point'. Never add a point without a sourceUrl. Set verified=true only after a teammate has checked it.
